fns.desc: eap_fast_build_pac writes `*pos++ = sm->identity_len;` truncating the size_t identity length to a single byte when building the PAC-Opaque Identity TLV; for an EAP identity longer than 255 bytes the recorded TLV length byte silently wraps while the subsequent os_memcpy still copies the full (untruncated) identity_len bytes, producing a corrupt/mismatched PAC-Opaque Identity entry (no buffer overflow, since pac_len sizing used the untruncated length, but a real wire-format correctness bug for long identities).
